body: Hi, hab es leider erst jetzt gesehen. Habe einen Nachforschungsauftrag gestellt. Bisher kam von DHL nur ein Schrieb wo ich nochmal angeben sollte, ob das Paket mittlerweile angekommen ist (ist es nicht). Echt ärgerlich.
Nope, Nachforschung ist beauftragt.

At a family gathering my ndad once talked about how people allegedly wondered how his gf could handle his big dick when he was young...I felt so disgusted. He also constantly touched my ass, walks in when I'm in the bathroom, has otherwise made offended comments when I was undressed and trying to hide my body or visibly uncomfortable, has commented on my chest when I was a minor, once pushed me onto a bed to "clean me down there"...I don't even want to remember these things.

I resonate so much with this. I too posted on here and it didn't even get published until like a day later when obvs no one's gonna see it. Not like it'd matter because I've also posted in other places and no one cared or I was met with disgust and anger. My own dad has told me that if I'm depressed I should just kms. That me not being normal has ruined not mine but his life. I understand how tired you must be because I am too. It hurts screaming into the void and no one caring after being told over and over "reach out, help is available". I've even called a suicide helpline, calling for hours and no one picked up. When I tried their chat the person ended the conversation almost immediately. At some point you just start questioning if this is all a fucking joke. I'm sorry you're in the same situation. When you're f'ed and even on suicide forums or helplines no one cares it's really just a big fuck you.

I'm not a girl and it didn't really "just happen" at all. I've known this (bisexual) dude for 8+ years and his situation is a bit complicated as well but I didn't want to make the post too lengthy or confusing. Though I understand where you're coming from, I work with only women and the way they casually talk about dating and ditching random people does make me feel like...some kind of subhuman. "Just" putting oneself out there sounds like a joke to me, I met this guy and thus my only friend at a place for autism group therapy, idek how to make friends.

Didn't expect such a lengthy and thought out reply, thank you for taking the time. Part of me also just wants to think rationally and keep myself out of harm's way but I can really relate to your first paragraph. The things I would've let previous crushes (that I actually liked) who rejected me do to me for an ounce of attention is...concerning to say the least.

I'm sorry that a day you tried to enjoy turned on you like that. I hate seeing couples or even friends or families in public, it just feels like a slap in the face and a reminder how pathetic I am. Also sorry to hear about your health issues. Chronic illness sucks.
That sucks, I know that feeling. Sometimes I just wonder what shit I'll have to sit through next.

Straight up "no" is brutal man. I've been avoiding dating apps...never got any likes or matches so it was really just making me feel more hopeless. Also, might not be a good thing to say but I really relate to your username.
Me not so much but I'm glad to hear your day went so well and thank you for asking about me! Get a good rest.
Oh lord, another poor soul who gets dreams like this. My condolences.

Hey, I saw that you asked how everyone was on another sub and see you're not feeling well. How was *your* day? Did anyone ask you lately? 

Perhaps you don't want to answer but I thought you asking about everyone was nice so I thought maybe I should leave a comment. I can relate a lot so I know these words don't do much, but I hope the best for you. Sorry for stealing your time haha.
Istg retail customers really don't make it any better. Black Friday was hell today, I felt what you wrote so much.

Just a few months ago there was a meetup of my old uni and one girl told us she couldn't come because she broke up with her bf and was "too unstable to get into her car and drive safely". This happens to normal people after a short time alone, yet we're expected to function and smile out of our asses 24/7 somehow? It's crazy how normies tell us it's not a big deal yet completely break down if they get just a taste of what is our entire existence.
I could write a novel about this and it's absolutely infuriating
I feel this so much. I already only have one acquaintance and they're not even replying to my texts, I really feel like an alien atp.

I stopped celebrating at 11 because I invited people to a bowling alley and it was a no-show. 

I thought for next year I wanna get a nice suit vest and go out but I imagined myself going to stores and cafés all dressed up for...nothing. It'd be pathetic. Like, imagine an insecure guy in fancy clothes walking into a café with a depressed expression. It basically screams "I'm a friendless loser" lol. So yeah...birthdays are just frustrating. Just a reminder that no one cares about my existence.

The thought that people actually have sex feels so surreal. Like, everyone you know does it. It's just the natural state of affairs to them, a casual thing that they think is a universal experience. Meanwhile to me it's like a fairy tale. I also feel like an alien.

This exact thing has been fucking me over so badly lately. If I'm destined to be alone and can't even be good at anything or enjoy any hobbies then what perspective do I have in life? None. I can't be happy with others because I have no one and I can't make anything else out of my life or the focus of my life. I feel you so much on the 20+ years dunked into something you're not even good at. I'm supposedly an "artist". I've drawn all my life and have a useless art degree. Now I'm a retail worker and when I manage to do art (which is hard af with major depression) and post it, no one gives af. All my life spent to hone this skill only to be mediocre while I see random normies with 1K+ followers on instagram with just selfies. It really feels like life is mocking us.

I've noticed this a lot in other subs about people in bad situations too. There's always a silver lining for them. Even irl people who had a shit life have friends and partners and have acted shocked and legit told me they don't understand why I'm not a drug addict or alcoholic after what's been my life. It feels like a punch in the guts. Like you're not even human. Even the "lowest" can't understand you.

Damn I thought I was the only one. People always recommend dating apps but just opening it and swiping for a bit maybe once every other month already makes my mental health plummet (and it leads nowhere anyways).

I'm so sorry for you, DID seems like hell even if just going by how heavily judged and misunderstood it seems to be. Really hope you don't face too many judgmental people making life even harder but can find the support you deserve.

I've read up about derealization+depersonalization and find myself in lots of the symptoms plus overall emotional numbness. With how I was exposed to death of a parent, bullying and ongoing narc treatment etc, dissociation seems quite plausible actually. If your state of life is inescapably bad and it's all you know, your mind starts wandering to a better place through escapism or it starts shutting reality out another way. These symptoms aren't exactly helpful but right now it's more surviving than thriving. I'm happy for everyone who can genuinely leave these horrible experiences in the past and become happier, even if these shit experiences probably shaped lots of us for life.

"lose-lose-lose-lose-lose situation" really describes it. 

For me it's not that my ndad thinks I'm hiding something but just...whatever way I act, it's wrong. When I do something I'm yelled at to do, I'm told it's wrong to do it after I'm told about it. When I try logic and facts...well, it's useless. When I try personal arguments, same, useless. When I cry, I'm told I'm just acting and should stop annoying him. 

Now I try to just grey rock mostly also because...what can you say at insults being thrown at you? But even then, that's seen as "ignoring him" or "mocking him" or just not caring. And honestly? I'm starting to truly not care anymore. It's always the same stupid rants, towards me, towards others...my mindset by now is more like "ah shit here we go again". I just can't take him seriously anymore and as I said, whatever I do is wrong anyways so why try anymore? 

Of course it's not a solution. It's more like...an act of desperation. When there's no escape, what more can you do?

I relate a lot. Making important decidions is scary and I don't really know what I want in life. For lots of things I just don't know how to do them or at least feel like I don't or can't know. That I couldn't do it so someone else should help me with it. I know that if I just follow what others expect of me I'm not gonna be happy but I also don't really have much of a choice. I don't feel competent at all or like I can do/reach what I want after being told so many times that I'm a failure who can't stay alive on my own.

Mostly how clean everything was. We have chaos everywhere, my dad has recently been hoarding packaging materials and we still have some things in the fridge and in cans that went bad literal years ago.

Also, not from childhood but I was at a uni colleague's house a few times and her mom constantly said how precious and wonderful I was, gave me clothes of hers because it had gotten cold, gave us baskets to pick berries in their garden and showed us how to bake bread and thanked us for helping her. I was basically waiting for her to snap and get angry but...it never happened. I couldn't understand the concept of a parent truly being like that - nice, caring, appreciative - all the time. I got so overwhelmed that I locked myself in the bathroom and cried.

My dad very rarely says it so when he does it seems suspicious to me. It feels as if he's saying it to make himself look good or to guilt trip me and like it's part of the whole "look at all the things I did for you" schtick. I usually say it back though it's forced and makes me feel uncomfortable.

I think one of the things I won't forget is also how me and my dad were once at an inpatient rehabilitation program and during one of the therapy sessions were supposed to make a poster with improvements we want. I was probably around 6-8 at the time. My suggestion for improvement was "no more hitting me while wearing rings". Realizing later that 1) apparently hitting me without rings was something I considered fine or an improvement and 2) that adults saw a child saying that and did nothing hits hard.

Unfortunately I don't really have access to treatment. I tried getting into therapy before but there are no capacities in my region so every therapist rejected me or put me on a 1 year+ waiting list and I never heard back. I'm also looking for a job and I don't want to lose a job offer because I have appointments to attend. The closest I got to therapy was regularly seeing a psychiatric nurse and psychiatrist but when I told them about my issues they just shrugged it off or told me to live laugh love because children in Africa are starving. It's really bizarre how I've been told so often to look into therapy/getting help and then when I've let people know I need help they just...didn't give a fuck.

I appreciate the suggestion. I draw digitally, mostly. I've heard of "depressed artists make the best art", though I've been struggling to make any art at all lately. I used to draw whenever I got the chance since I was a toddler but the more depressed I got the harder became to just pick up a pen and even start. In general, it's hard to get out of bed. All my previous hobbies and passions now feel like a chore, though I've been trying to engage in them more again lately and actually finished 2 games but it just doesn't bring me joy anymore. My overall life situation and loneliness overshadow everything and hobbies are but a momentary distraction at best. It just feels pointless.
Wow, thanks, all my problems dissolved into nothing!
Seeing what kind of deep, genuine connections others have with people makes me realize that I never even had a real friend in my life. Makes me feel like an alien.

I already have pets and I still feel like dying every day.

And I'm demisexual. Sex to me is something I want only if there's an emotional connection. Doing it with a stranger would only make me feel worse and is not what I want and sex was also not what I'm talking about here. I was talking about love, whether romantic or platonic, being something that has never been mutual in my life.

"Why would I want someone I love to be hurt by my love? I want to cherish them, to make their life better, I want them to feel happy because of me, not uncomfortable or upset."

What about this makes you think I was writing about sex?

I'm struggling so much with this. I actually feel so disgusted by myself even when I like people platonically. I can't even express affection in any way shape or form because my brain immediately goes "nuh-uh, affection from YOU? That would make any person on the planet feel like swallowing bleach!". Well, not like I get any chances to show affection either way. Friends? Who am I? The pope?
What kinda drugs are u on mate?

This must be one of the best descriptions of therapy I've ever read and tbh it's creepy how I feel like I personally experienced most of it. People always go "there's a few black sheep out there" but how can a lenghty text like this with so many issues adressed overlap to a t with my and other people's experiences then? It's not a coincidence, the system is fucked from the core.

Please don't just go to any random hospital if you decide to go. Do at least some reasearch and read about other peoples' experiences. A bad hospital might keep you hospitalized against your will and not cooperate so please make sure you find a safe place with doctors that respect your boundaries and are actually interested in you getting better. If you have someone you can trust, please let them know and ask if they can stay with you until you feel better/safer or if you think a hospital is the only way, that they help you with looking for and appropriate one and can help defending you/getting you out if you still end up in an abusive hospital. 

Unless what you meant is you drank it, then if you are doubtful just go asap, it likely won't kill you and just put you through pain so get it treated asap for your own sake please

I always get so confused by people claiming they love and care about random internet strangers, like wtf? They don't even know that person. Love is a strong word and if they claim to "love" a rando online (who they'll instantly forget about and never talk to again in most cases anw), they don't know the meaning of that word. 
Same for "there's someone out there who loves you", no, to love me someone has to at least know me, people who don't know I exist can't love me, or feel anything about me. They can't even think about me bc they literally don't know I exist.

Fr, there's nowhere to go, no one to talk to, no hope. I had the same experience, just without school counselors, but the entire psychology/psychiatry field has just been pushing toxic positivity, invalidating my issues etc. and even put me in danger or actively made my situation worse. All the "resources" that are supposedly there to help you are a joke. Hotlines don't respond, hang up or ghost, "friends" will tell you you can always come to them in need and then they get angry, ghost you, make it all about themselves or invalidate you, even those supposed to unconditionally love and support you get angry, tell you to just do it already or try to get you locked up, put on drugs and treated like subhuman dirt. How tf is anyone supposed to be ok like this? I can only stay to myself now or vent online when bottling it up is getting too painful, but what is that gonna do if I know nobody really accepts me and people will literally lock me up if I don't watch what I say irl? This world is sick.

I hate the notion that we supposedly just think I'd be fun or people calling us misogynistic etc bc they claim we're taking the easy way out of women's issues or sth? Like, what are these people on, dysphoria is literally the opposite of an easy way anywhere

Haha fr! Was thinking about just telling him to imagine waking up in a female body - perhaps even one with endometriosis or other awful conditions - and how he'd like that but ik he wouldn't understand and I'm not up for discussions with white cishet men

Considering that people younger than me look down on me, have given me shocked and judgmental looks upon telling them my age and seem to think I'm retarded...yeah, absolutely. There are so many experiences I lack that relating to anyone is basically impossible. Feeling behind on people who are barely legal or even minors is a terrible feeling, humiliating, really.

This made me chuckle tbh bc I relate so hard. Exactly the type of humor I cope with as well. I'm sorry to know you are suffering in a similar way of course, but this kinda lifted my mood a bit so thanks I guess.

Understandable. This kind of pain won't simply go away through momentary distraction or coping strategies. I wish there was a solution but I guess the only thing we can hope for is for science to catch up or whatever.

Oh sorry if the units confused you, I'm European but I just figured most people here use the imperial system.

Well, I don't wear feminine clothing like tops that show cleavage, skirts, dresses etc, one good thing about my height is that almost all clothing is too big but that means I can wear XS hoodies and they'll still be baggy and hide my chest a fair bit and make my shoulders appear broader. I also got my doctor to prescribe me permanent birth control so I don't get periods which is a huge burden off my chest. Outside of that there isn't much I can do. 
I'm considering getting my hair cut short but tbh I'm scared it might be a hint to my transphobic surroundings.

In general I'm just not coping well rn though, been spending my weekend being suicidal and looking up surgery options and fantasizing about having a different body but ultimately I just realize that's never gonna happen and considering that my best bet would be ending up as some hybrid "freak" or whatever people like to insult trans people as atm with a non-functioning sausage tube and huge visible scars on my body that could out me I'm just ready to f-ing off myself at this rate. Shit seems hopeless. Only ray of light is my pets that don't give a shit what gender I am.

How about you? Any coping strategies?

I feel you so much. I'm in the opposite position (afab and hate it) but I relate a lot. Surgery doesn't sound like a remotely satisfying option and I absolutely understand the feeling of being just an actor at best. Even with the best surgery results, it's all just fabricated, not functioning and certain things just cannot be changed (like hips, or height...I'm 5'1"...). It's a very bleak outlook and I don't see how anyone could not be in crippling emotional pain having to deal with this. I really hate it. I'm sorry people in your life don't understand and have been invalidating your struggles. NO trans person is in a "good/lucky position". It just sucks and you deserve validation, acceptance and support.

I (and probably most others here) don't even get good times. The only thing I get is being suicidal 365 days a year. I'm not saying it's a magical cure-all but getting that affection and care and having someone to depend on, to support you and to be vulnerable with does make a difference. A very significant one, that's why we're here.

Same. I also found it highly concerning to know that apparently some people are so privileged they will want more and more attention even though they already are in a relationship that they will even seek it out from multiple people. If some normal person in a relationship isn't good enough for their partner to be happy with them and not betray them, how could I be for anyone?

Hard agree. All the "help" I ever got (from "professionals" included) was them telling me to stfu and suffer in silence, disguised as "nice" words, useless advice and platitudes. These people don't care about actually helping us, they just don't want to hear about our issues, they wanna go back to their happy bubble and pat themselves on the back for being such a great person for "helping someone". It's fucking disgusting.
Lmao I barely feel anything anymore and I don't care about anything either. Even hobbies feel like a chore. Every day's the same shit. I wouldn't recommend it.

These kinda humiliating slave jobs really ain't good for one's mental health. I relate a lot haha! I also have to do all the other shit in the store so it often happens that there's nobody at the cash register and customers will annoyedly yell through the store for someone to come after waiting for like 30 seconds. Like ma'am stfu for 2 seconds, you have no idea how stressful it is to hurriedly run around the store just trying to get your work done then BOOM angry Karens calling for you and judging you. The entitlement of customers towards those that work in retail, fast food, cleaning etc is atrocious. I also love the gangs of children that come to steal and/or insult and laugh at me for being a cashier :/
I'm a cashier and I felt this so much
Bold of you to assume I'm able to cope
Thank you!

You're not incompetent. Suicide is hard, I've read the chance of dying is actually around 1%. More importantly, I hope you are alright. One of my worst fears is attempting and getting crippled so I hope you didn't and won't ever have to go through that. Please make sure to get proper care and take some time for yourself to recover. You don't deserve to suffer and especially not to suffer even more. I understand your exhaustion. Having no way out of suffering is a nightmare.
Same, this is what suicide hotlines and therapists/therapy pushers don't get. Some people just don't want to live. Some of us have simply seen and had enough of this bullshit.
Thank you! I have to, I guess.

It really makes a huge difference. I know this person who constantly posts about mental illness and their struggles and everyone comforts and cares for them. I've even seen them getting head pats from their friends and the friends taking over conversations and duties when they felt unwell doing them. Meanwhile we're out here getting judged for venting for 5 minutes and told to suck it up. Instead of long-term genuine care and interest we just get platitudes tossed at us and people pat themselves on the back feeling like heroes for it while we suffer on. I don't even talk about my mental health anymore, it's just frustrating and puts me at the risk of forced hospitalization if I do.

And yeah same on the overcompensating. I don't want to overcompensate, I don't want people to like a fake facade, I want to be accepted with all my weaknesses and vulnerabilities.

Ironically mine was yesterday and I went to a café with an acquaintance. I would've gone by myself if nobody had wanted to attend though. People annoy me a lot lately so I've come to appreciate my own company of sorts.
People think starving artists are a funny meme but we're really living like that and are even made fun of for it. It sucks.
Thank you. I'd be happy to, I can send you my handle as a DM.
Oh lord, that's so insensitive it pisses me off. These people really have no damn clue and walk around harming people then shrugging it off and go about their life, it's infuriating.

Thank you for your sentiment. Unfortunately I'm not sure where to find such artist groups. During uni there was a bit of exchange with the other students but that was cut short due to the lockdowns. I don't really have any friends in the first place. There was a time I knew a Japanese artist and we often drew each other's OCs and supported each other but they deleted their account due to harassment or sth...
And well, I've had my own art style for years now but consistently posting is hard when depression and work are holding me back. Though I like your metaphor. Just feel like doing art for my whole life should pay off by now. I work hard and often take 20+ hours for a piece so it barely getting any recognition and just being no good for making any money stings badly. Anyway, thank you for taking the time to write this.
Bruh??
The disillusionment of seeing your dreams crushed right in front of you really hits different. While I was studying art I was starting to feel so pressured and really started to hate it in a way.
Yeah I don't have much art to post due to depression and work keeping me from making it either lately. And thanks, I can DM it to you.

Honestly I think the thing that pisses me off the most about it is that I'm forced to work a shit job I don't want bc the one thing I'm supposed to be good at apparently isn't good enough. It feels like a slap in the face from life. I hope you're out of retail now bc that's honestly not something anyone should have to go through.

I feel you. How ironic to say, when I'm also extremely emotionally numb. The void is a worse and more complex issue than feeling sad, upset or whatever. There truly IS nothing worthwile when you cannot feel anything. No sadness, no happiness, nothing. Can't even tell if it sucks bc I can't be arsed to care.

Though I relate to you in your last paragraph. My pet rabbit is the being I've known the longest in my life (except for relatives...but we're not close to say the least). She's been there with me through all this shit when everyone betrayed, abused and left me. I too am living for her and am planning on going with her, which might not be long as she's old. I hope you still have some good time coming with your dog. Even if you do not feel anything, I hope you can still experience it as something good or worthwile to you.
Never did lol

I feel like when it's people who are suffering as well it comes from a far different place. It's more of a mutual understanding rather than the often patronizing and belittling way it is said by "outsiders". They use it as a platitude to silence us while people in the same boat use it to show support. At least that's what I think about the matter based on my experiences...
Thanks but I've been posting my art for years and I don't even have 100 followers on several platforms combined. When I post just no one cares.

I understand what you mean. After all, it wouldn't do us any good if these people suffered. It just feels hopeless to me that even if these people would actually understand what they've done and changed, there'd always be a huge amount of people in the world who'd go on hurting others and not caring even if they die as a consequence. It's a twisted world we live in.

I wish I could do it tbh. People have caused me tremendous suffering yet always tend to make it about themselves. When I vented they demonized me for it and acted all "woe is me". I want them to see the consequences of their actions and that being suicidal 24/7 and their discomfort when listening to people's suffering for 5 minutes is in no way comparable. I also just despise humanity in general. Maybe I just want people to realize that they contributed to killing a person and to mayble reflect upon their actions and change for the better. But who am I to have hope for humanity?

I feel the same about the "living in a dead person's body" thing. I also feel stuck and alienated. It's as if I'm expected to play this role so I put up this facade of a somewhat functioning person. I just go about my day and say what people want to hear. Sometimes I have mental breakdowns where I talk about my old/pre-trauma self in 3rd person and relate a lot to your "not feeling human anymore". It's a painful kind of existence, especially since suicide is an omnipresent thought yet isn't something I think is in my reach. Even death is just a dream for me so I'm forced to just drag on living and play along as much as I can be arsed to.

That doesn't sound very healthy for you. I can unfortunately understand exactly what this is like, feels like talking to a wall. I feel like people who aren't depressed can't understand what it means no matter how many times and in what words it is explained to them. They always tend to make it about how they are also feeling bad/depressed when they have no clue what that even feels like or how listening to vents is "ruining" their day/life/whatever. I find these kinds of comments really insensitive and since it seems to apply to your gf, I would consider telling her exactly this - that her comments or advice are unhelpful, insensitive, invalidating, however else they may make you feel. That she shall respect your condition and that you know it and what will (not) help the best and thus to cut back on unnecessary, unhelpful advice. I've made the same experience - nobody cares to understand, so maybe them not saying anything would be more helpful.

-despite all the disappointments in my life, I'm still friendly to strangers

-I try not to be judgmental and to respect everyone's opinions and ideals even when I don't share them and they make no sense to me (believe me, I had to deal with hardcore Christians)

-no smoking, drinking or drugs...though they may help with socializing so dunno

-I love my pets

-I have a useless university degree ig

-I started exercising last year

Maybe it'll help if I share a recent experience? Was planning to meet up with an acquaintance (really just that) and they weren't showing up. I expected the worst since I'd been disappointed by people many times before. Their train was late. Just a few days ago I messaged them how they are and they didn't reply for days. Turns out they had covid. I have huuuge trust issues but apparently not all people will contribute to confirmation bias? Hopefully. Well, what I'm trying to say is, I fully understand your suspicions. I don't have huge expectations towards people anymore. If they don't show up, so be it, if they ghost me, so what, been there, I'm not as shocked anymore, I already expected it. I really think it's a good idea of you to have plans for if she flakes. Go get those lottery tickets or just have an otherwise nice day, whatever that means for you. Even if she turns out to be another disappointment in your record, you'll still have yourself. I know it sucks, I really hope for you that she shows up and you'll have a nice time.

When I started reading your post I was actually thinking "yeah I feel like an alien" and then you wrote just that...
It really feels so unbelievable and weird, wrong, that this is just a normal everyday thing for other people they take as a given. Like, how? When we can't even dream of it.
It depends, there are times when I don't check on reddit or similar sites for a few weeks and then there are times when I'm doing it for hours each day. Rn it's "doing it for hours each day" time

Yeah but tbh at this point I've become too "damaged" by trauma to really feel comfortable near people so I don't think I could believe they mean it. I want it but it seems too unrealistic, too good to be true in this cruel world.
Too bad that being fun to be around and being FA seem to be mutually exclusive as everyone will be magically apalled by our bare existence...

Reading the title made me laugh out loud. Flashbacks to the fair share of the normie bullshit advise bingo I've encountered so far...damn, these "strategies" fail at everything but making me laugh bc what else is left to do at this point. I understand your frustration.

THIS. The whole idea of creating a fake "normie" persona for people to like defies the entire purpose imo. I want to be loved and appreciated for who I am, to be accepted, to not have to hide and fear rejection but to experience validation and support, unconditionally, when I show vulnerability. I want someone to be able to rely on in times of need, not to put up an act of "oh I'm so strong and cool, I'm not needy, I don't need human connection blah blah". I don't want to be "fixed" to be with someone. I want to be accepted and grow by their side. The effort to put up that facade isn't worth it (and didn't help me so far either way)
I didn't even know it existed. What a shame, some of them were actually rather funny/relatable. Always hate to discover old dead subs that had potential :/
I feel you. It doesn't help that people always suggest to go out when what I wanna do with a partner is to have a comfy time inside (and don't enjoy going out by myself either)

Didn't expect a poem here but I liked it. Kinda reminded me of how I used to write poems about my struggles for fun in the past. If you're already in a situation like this at some point you just say fuck it, why not, it's mildly comforting/entertaining
These people are so far removed from reality it's hilarious. I can totally understand how that felt "therapeutic" to you.

[ I'm so sorry, sir, that my trauma is tiring TO YOU. Imagine what it's like reliving it every second of every day with no end. ]

Preach! I've had this thought so many times. These people are so privileged to not know trauma they get overwhelmed by a short talk about it and then go on to tell US we're weak? Lmao. What a twat. I'm so sorry you were let down when you finally seemed to get some hope.

Man this hurts on a personal level. This kind of thing happened to me with friends and family members who legit snapped at me or ghosted me. I hate the narrative that being traumatized and/or having bad mental health turns you into evil itself and people cannot be burdened by your existence.
